Privacy Notice - Nimbus Finance

This notice explains how Nimbus Finance Limited handles your personal data.

Why we need your data
We use your personal data to verify your identity, assess loan applications, collect repayments and meet our legal duties. We will not use it for other purposes without asking you first.

Your choices
You can ask us at any time to show you the personal data we hold about you, to fix anything that is wrong or out of date, or to delete your data. You can also take back any permission you gave us earlier, and you can name someone who may act for you if you are unable to.

Who to talk to
Our Data Protection Officer, Mr. Imran Qureshi, is the person who answers questions about how we process your personal data. Write to dpo@nimbusfin.example or call 1800 123 4567.

How long we keep records
Loan records are kept for eight years after closure of the account, as required by law.
